 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 2649/2023 Suresh Kumar S/o Sh. Jairam, Aged About 32 Years, Dhamana Ka Goliya, Sanchore Police Station, Dist. Jalore.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
(Confined In Sub Jail Sanchore).
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Sudhir Saruparia For Respondent(s) : Mr. SK Bhati, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MADAN GOPAL VYAS Order 22/03/2023
The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No. 157/2021 of Police Station - Sanchore, District Jalore for the offences punishable under Sections 420 & 409 of IPC.
He has preferred this bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in this present case.

It is further submitted that the alleged offences are triable by First Class Magistrate and the co-accused Mohni Devi has already been granted bail by coordinate bench of this Court vide order dated 03.02.2023 passed in SB Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.325/2023.

entities.text: SB Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.325/2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The accused-petitioner is in custody since long and the trial of the case will take long time.
Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
[2023/RJJD/007298] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-2649/2023] Learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application.

Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it just and proper to grant bail to the accused petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
